scope: design only; no executable or operational acceptance
implementation_requirements: Preserve exact storage identities/configuration; refuse missing namespaces; separately establish image, SDK and builder compatibility
Rollback removes only attempt-owned replacements and restarts only interrupted originals in dependency order
Disclosed audit/log appends are permitted write exceptions and are not reversible by application rollback; no source-document/schema mutation
Timed Docker stop can force termination; existing stop(...,8) is not proof of graceful-only behavior and cannot bypass the proposed forced-termination prohibition
Preparation, cutover, verification, receipts and recovery share one 600-second deadline with 180 seconds reserved for recovery; do not concatenate independent controller budgets
Reconcile uncertain lifecycle outcomes; preserve recoverable artifacts and report incomplete recovery when safe restoration cannot finish
Private-memory credential use requires separate authorization; no secret values or hashes in persisted receipts
One guarded dashboard request only; no fallback, retry, new framework, trading, ingestion or migration
next_proof: Focused offline implementation and tests, independent review of frozen executable delta, fresh bindings, then separate operational approval
source: independent reviewer response in this Codex conversation
